title: Symmetry in Nature
excerpt: A case study on Symmetric Patterns evident in nature called "fractals", asking why they tends to occur, and is there any way to classify them(?).
content: # Symmetry of Nature And the Human Mind Symmetry is the ultimate truth of the nature. The truth that gets manifested in forms of beautiful designs and patterns. Symmetric patters and data in this universe is very relevant and in deeper sense it is what, helps us to study the laws of the nature. The Human mind is very pattern oriented. It tries to grab any symmetrical data it can grab, and extrapolate it to come to a conclusion. The Symmetry in nature, that we can see around us are in some sense, the amalgamation of structured, pattern oriented data and geometry. Whenever we collect Raw data from scientific readings, most of it is "noise", the numbers that are inbuilt choatic, and can't be interpreted to produce any inference.
